records.package_name: 2 Day Bromo Sunrise Adventure from Surabaya

itinerary_days.title: Day 1
itinerary_days.activity_text: Your adventure begins with a pickup in Surabaya at your hotel, train station, or international airport (ideally before 03:00 PM). Travel to Cemoro Lawang, a serene village near Mount Bromo (approx. 3–4 hours). En route, stop for lunch at a local restaurant in Probolinggo (at your own expense). Afterward, proceed to your hotel for check-in and rest. The evening is free for you to relax and prepare for the early morning adventure.

itinerary_days.title: Day 2
itinerary_days.itinerary: Bromo Sunrise - Madakaripura Waterfall - Surabaya Airport
itinerary_days.activity_text: Mount Bromo Stargazing and Sunrise Tour: Begin your day at 2:00 AM, departing for Mount Bromo Stargazing. Witness the stunning Milky Way in a sky untouched by light pollution. As dawn approaches, enjoy breathtaking sunrise views over the Bromo landscape. Marvel at the iconic peaks of Mount Batok, Mount Bromo, and the towering Gunung Semeru, Java’s highest volcano. From there, take a thrilling 4WD or motorcycle ride across the Sand Sea to Poten, a Tenggerese Hindu temple. Choose to hike 3 km or take a pony ride to the base of Mount Bromo. Climb a steep 253-step staircase for a close-up view of the volcanic crater rim. Breakfast and Madakaripura Waterfall Adventure: After exploring Mount Bromo, return to your hotel in Cemoro Lawang to rest, enjoy breakfast, and check out by 12:00 PM. Continue the journey with a 1-hour drive to Madakaripura Waterfall, a mesmerizing natural wonder surrounded by lush greenery. Trek for about 30 minutes, accompanied by a local guide, to reach the waterfall. Wear waterproof slippers and prepare to be awed by the towering cascades. Afterward, begin your 4-hour journey back to Surabaya, concluding the program. Drop-off will be at your hotel, train station, or airport in Surabaya (recommended flights after 7:00 PM).

records.package_name: 4 Day Tumpak Sewu, Bromo & Ijen Adventure from Surabaya to Bali

itinerary_days.title: Day 1
itinerary_days.activity_text: Your adventure begins with a pickup at Surabaya Airport (ideally before 12 PM). Afterward, you’ll be transferred to Lumajang (Tumpak Sewu area), which takes approximately 4 hours, with a stop at a local restaurant for lunch (at your own expense). Upon arrival in Lumajang, check into your hotel and enjoy free time to explore or relax.

itinerary_days.title: Day 2
itinerary_days.activity_text: Your day begins with breakfast from hotel and start to exploring Tumpak Sewu Waterfall, one of the most stunning waterfalls in Java. Known for its unique curtain-like water flow and multiple smaller falls, Tumpak Sewu’s beauty will take your breath away. The trek to the waterfall involves following a river up the canyon and crossing the river at one point (make sure to wear proper trekking shoes). After enjoying the waterfall, take time to relax and have lunch. You’ll then continue the journey to Cemoro Lawang, near Mount Bromo, with a drive of approximately 4 hours. Upon arrival, check in to your hotel and relax overnight in preparation for the next day's adventure.

itinerary_days.title: Day 3
itinerary_days.activity_text: Start the day early at 2:00 AM to prepare for Mount Bromo stargazing and the Milky Way view. After witnessing the stunning night sky, enjoy the famous sunrise over the Bromo landscape, with views of Mount Batok, Mount Bromo, and Gunung Semeru. Following the sunrise, take a 4WD ride across the Sand Sea to Poten, a Hindu temple. From there, you can either take a 3 km hike or a pony ride to the base of Mount Bromo to get close-up views of the crater. After exploring Mount Bromo, continue to the Whispering Sands for more scenic views. Return to your hotel for breakfast, shower, and checkout. Afterward, you'll be transferred to a hotel in Bondowoso, with a 3-hour drive and a stop for lunch at a local restaurant (at your own expense). Upon arrival, check into your hotel and enjoy a relaxing evening.

itinerary_days.title: Day 4
itinerary_days.activity_text: Start at 12:00 AM, checking out from your hotel and driving to the Paltuding trailhead for Ijen Crater (about 90 minutes). From there, trek approximately 1-1.5 hours to the crater rim, where you’ll witness the spectacular turquoise sulfuric crater lake. You’ll also have the chance to observe sulfur miners carrying heavy loads of sulfur despite the harsh conditions. Enjoy the sunrise at the crater before heading back down. After Ijen Crater, drive to Ketapang Harbor and take the ferry to Bali (about 1.5 hours). Your adventure concludes upon arrival in Bali.

records.package_name: 3 Day Bromo, Madakaripura Waterfall & Ijen Overland from Surabaya to Bali

itinerary_days.title: Day 1
itinerary_days.itinerary: From Surabaya to the Mystical Bromo Area
itinerary_days.activity_text: Your Bromo and Ijen adventure begins as we greet you at Surabaya Airport, with an early pick-up (best before noon). From there, we’ll embark on a 3-hour scenic drive to the iconic Cemoro Lawang, the gateway to the Bromo Area. Along the way, enjoy the changing landscapes of East Java as we make our way to the hotel. Upon arrival at your hotel, Joglo Kecombrang Bromo, you’ll have time to rest and take in the quiet beauty of the surroundings. Prepare for the exciting days ahead as you settle in for a peaceful evening.

itinerary_days.title: Day 2
itinerary_days.itinerary: From Bromo Sunrise to the Hidden Gems of Madakaripura
itinerary_days.activity_text: Our day begins in the early hours (around 1:00 AM), with a thrilling stargazing session, followed by a view of the Milky Way. As the first light of dawn breaks, witness the spectacular sunrise over the volcanic landscape of Bromo. The dormant Mount Batok, the active Mount Bromo, and the towering Mount Semeru are all part of this majestic view that stretches across the caldera. After sunrise, we continue our journey over the expansive Pasir (Sand Sea) in a 4WD, heading to the Poten Temple. From here, you can choose to either take a 3km hike or ride a pony to the base of Mount Bromo. A steep 253-step climb rewards you with a close-up view of the crater rim, where you can witness the raw power of the active volcano. We then set off for Madakaripura Waterfall, about an hour’s drive away. A short 30-minute trek through the lush greenery (wear your slippers!) will lead you to this magnificent waterfall, a stunning natural beauty nestled deep in the hills. After taking in the sight, we continue our journey to Bondowoso for an overnight stay.

itinerary_days.title: Day 3
itinerary_days.itinerary: From Ijen Crater to Bali’s Shores
itinerary_days.activity_text: Your day begins at midnight, as we head out from Bondowoso to Ijen. After a 90-minute drive to Paltuding, we’ll start the trek to Ijen Crater. This 1 to 1.5-hour hike leads you to the crater rim, where you’ll stand in awe of the 200-meter deep, turquoise sulfuric lake. You’ll also get to witness the grueling work of the local sulfur miners as they carry heavy sacks through toxic fumes and harsh terrain to make a living. After experiencing the crater’s sunrise view, we’ll descend and proceed to Ketapang Harbour, where you’ll board the ferry to Bali (ticket included). The journey to the island is the perfect way to conclude your Ijen adventure, as we leave Java behind and head to the tropical paradise of Bali.

records.package_name: 3 Day Bromo, Madakaripura Waterfall & Ijen Overland from Surabaya to Bali

itinerary_days.title: Day 1
itinerary_days.itinerary: From Surabaya to the Mystical Bromo Area
itinerary_days.activity_text: Your Bromo and Ijen adventure begins as we greet you at Surabaya Airport, with an early pick-up (best before noon). From there, we’ll embark on a 3-hour scenic drive to the iconic Cemoro Lawang, the gateway to the Bromo Area. Along the way, enjoy the changing landscapes of East Java as we make our way to the hotel. Upon arrival at your hotel, Joglo Kecombrang Bromo, you’ll have time to rest and take in the quiet beauty of the surroundings. Prepare for the exciting days ahead as you settle in for a peaceful evening.

itinerary_days.title: Day 2
itinerary_days.itinerary: From Bromo Sunrise to the Hidden Gems of Madakaripura
itinerary_days.activity_text: Our day begins in the early hours (around 1:00 AM), with a thrilling stargazing session, followed by a view of the Milky Way. As the first light of dawn breaks, witness the spectacular sunrise over the volcanic landscape of Bromo. The dormant Mount Batok, the active Mount Bromo, and the towering Mount Semeru are all part of this majestic view that stretches across the caldera. After sunrise, we continue our journey over the expansive Pasir (Sand Sea) in a 4WD, heading to the Poten Temple. From here, you can choose to either take a 3km hike or ride a pony to the base of Mount Bromo. A steep 253-step climb rewards you with a close-up view of the crater rim, where you can witness the raw power of the active volcano. We then set off for Madakaripura Waterfall, about an hour’s drive away. A short 30-minute trek through the lush greenery (wear your slippers!) will lead you to this magnificent waterfall, a stunning natural beauty nestled deep in the hills. After taking in the sight, we continue our journey to Bondowoso for an overnight stay.

itinerary_days.title: Day 3
itinerary_days.itinerary: From Ijen Crater to Bali’s Shores
itinerary_days.activity_text: Your day begins at midnight, as we head out from Bondowoso to Ijen. After a 90-minute drive to Paltuding, we’ll start the trek to Ijen Crater. This 1 to 1.5-hour hike leads you to the crater rim, where you’ll stand in awe of the 200-meter deep, turquoise sulfuric lake. You’ll also get to witness the grueling work of the local sulfur miners as they carry heavy sacks through toxic fumes and harsh terrain to make a living. After experiencing the crater’s sunrise view, we’ll descend and proceed to Ketapang Harbour, where you’ll board the ferry to Bali (ticket included). The journey to the island is the perfect way to conclude your Ijen adventure, as we leave Java behind and head to the tropical paradise of Bali.

itinerary_days.activity_text: The day begins at midnight with a transfer to the Paltuding trailhead (about 1.5 hours). Start your trek (1-1.5 hours) to the crater rim of Mount Ijen. Witness the stunning turquoise sulfuric crater lake and observe sulfur miners carrying heavy loads despite challenging conditions. Enjoy the sunrise view over the crater before descending. After your trek, stop at Malabar Coffee for coffee and snacks. Then, head to Bondowoso City for lunch at a local restaurant. Continue the journey to Jember City and check in to your hotel. At 3 PM, visit Papuma Beach (1-hour drive). Be captivated by the mesmerizing sunset views over the sea. Return to your hotel in Jember for an overnight stay.

itinerary_days.title: Day 3
itinerary_days.activity_text: Start early at 3.30 AM and check out from your hotel. Travel to Tumpak Sewu Waterfall, often regarded as the most beautiful waterfall in Java. Its unique formation resembles a curtain of water cascading from 300-meter-high cliffs. Trek through the canyon, following the river and crossing it at one point to fully experience the falls. Trekking sandals or shoes are highly recommended. After enjoying the waterfall and a water spa, have lunch before driving approximately 4 hours to your hotel in the Bromo area. Check in and rest for the next day’s adventure.

itinerary_days.activity_text: Our adventure begins at 2:00 AM, as we head out to witness the dazzling Milky Way and the unforgettable sunrise over Mount Bromo. The caldera’s flat sea of volcanic sand gives way to the striking silhouettes of Mount Batok, the smoking Mount Bromo, and in the distance, the majestic Mount Semeru—the tallest and most active volcano in Java. After soaking in the sunrise, we’ll ride across the iconic Sand Sea in a 4WD to Poten, a serene Tenggerese Hindu temple at the base of Mount Bromo. From here, you can either trek 3 km or opt for a pony ride to reach the foot of Mount Bromo. A short climb up 253 steps will bring you to the crater rim, where you’ll stand in awe of the volcano’s raw power and beauty. Next, we drive an hour to the stunning Madakaripura Waterfall. A short 30-minute trek, guided by a local expert, leads us to this enchanting natural wonder hidden amidst towering cliffs. Don’t forget your slippers—you’ll be wading through shallow streams! After the waterfall, we’ll begin the scenic 4-hour journey back to your hotel or the airport in Surabaya, marking the end of our unforgettable program. (Please note: Ensure your flight departs after 7 PM on day 3.)

itinerary_days.title: Day 1
itinerary_days.activity_text: Your exciting Bromo and Ijen adventure begins with a warm welcome at Surabaya Airport. We’ll pick you up (best before noon) and start our scenic 5-hour drive to Bondowoso. Along the way, we’ll stop at a local restaurant in Probolinggo for lunch at your own expense. Enjoy the changing landscapes as you make your way towards Bondowoso. After arriving at hotel in Bondowoso, take some time to relax and settle in. Enjoy a delicious dinner and rest up for the next day’s adventure.

itinerary_days.title: Day 2
itinerary_days.activity_text: Your day starts early at midnight with a drive to Paltuding, the base of Ijen Crater. After about 1.5 hours on the road, you’ll begin your 1-1.5 hour trek to the crater rim. Upon reaching the rim, you’ll be greeted by the breathtaking sight of the 200-meter deep turquoise sulfuric lake, set against a dramatic volcanic landscape. Witness the extraordinary work of sulfur miners who carry heavy loads through hazardous terrain and toxic fumes. After enjoying the sunrise at Ijen Crater, we stop at the Malabar Coffee Plantation for a refreshing coffee break and snacks. Then, we return to your hotel in Bondowoso for a shower and check-out before heading to the next destination. In the afternoon, we journey to Jember City, where you’ll check in at Doho Homestay. After a brief rest, we set off for Papuma Beach, a one-hour drive away. Be mesmerized by the stunning sunset views over the sea, offering the perfect end to a day filled with natural wonders.

itinerary_days.title: Day 3
itinerary_days.activity_text: Our journey begins early at 4:00 AM as we check out and head to Tumpak Sewu Waterfall, one of the most beautiful waterfalls in Java. Known for its unique half-circle formation, the waterfall consists of multiple mini-waterfalls cascading from a height of around 300 meters. A short, adventurous trek takes you across rocks and streams to reach the waterfall, so be sure to bring appropriate trekking sandals or shoes. After exploring the falls and perhaps even enjoying a natural water spa, we will have lunch before continuing our journey to the Bromo area. The drive will take approximately 4 hours, bringing you closer to the iconic Bromo Volcano.

itinerary_days.title: Day 4
itinerary_days.activity_text: Prepare for an early morning adventure starting at 2:00 AM as we set out for stargazing and a Milky Way view at Mount Bromo. As the first rays of dawn break, witness the spectacular sunrise over the Bromo landscape. The majestic views of Mount Batok, Mount Bromo, and Mount Semeru will take your breath away, as they rise from the flat volcanic sand bed of the caldera. After sunrise, we will continue our journey on a thrilling 4WD ride over the vast Sand Sea to the Poten Temple. From here, you can either take a 3km hike or a pony ride to the base of Mount Bromo, where you will ascend 253 steps to reach the crater rim and witness the raw power of the volcano up close. After a morning filled with adventure, we will head back to Surabaya. Depending on your travel plans, we recommend booking a flight or train departing after 6:00 PM. End your trip with wonderful memories of East Java’s volcanic wonders.

itinerary_days.activity_text: Your tour begins with a pick-up at I Gusti Ngurah Rai International Airport (DPS) in Bali or from your hotel (preferably before 9:00 AM local time). You will be transferred for approximately 4 hours to Gilimanuk Port for your ferry crossing to Java (Ketapang Port). The ferry crossing will take around an hour, and if the weather is clear, you can enjoy views of Mount Agung in Bali and Mount Raung in Java from the ferry. Upon arrival at Ketapang Port, continue your journey with a 4-hour drive to your hotel in the Bromo area. Check in, relax, and rest before your next adventure

itinerary_days.title: Day 2
itinerary_days.activity_text: At around 02:00 AM, prepare for a thrilling Mount Bromo Stargazing and Milky Way View. After immersing yourself in the beauty of the night sky, head to the viewing spot for sunrise over the Bromo landscape. You'll witness the stunning sight of Mount Batok, Mount Bromo, and Gunung Semeru, Indonesia's highest and most active volcano, looming majestically in the background. After the sunrise, embark on an exciting 4WD ride or motorcycle journey across the vast volcanic sand sea (Laotan Pasir) to Poten, a Tenggerese Hindu temple near Mount Bromo. From here, you have the option to either hike 3km or take a pony ride to the base of Mount Bromo, where you can climb the 253 steps to the crater rim for close-up views of the active crater. After enjoying the spectacular views of the Bromo crater, continue your journey to Bondowoso City. Check into your hotel and recharge your energy in preparation for the Ijen Crater hike the next day.

itinerary_days.title: Day 3
itinerary_days.activity_text: Your Ijen adventure begins at midnight with a 90-minute drive from the hotel to the Ijen Ranger Post (Paltuding). Upon arrival, begin the trek to Ijen Crater, which will take approximately 1 to 1.5 hours. At the crater rim, be mesmerized by the gigantic turquoise sulfuric crater lake, one of the most unique sights in Java. While at the crater, you'll have the chance to observe the world’s toughest sulfur miners who brave toxic fumes and hazardous terrain to carry 70kg sacks of sulfur. This is a truly humbling experience that reveals the hardships faced by these workers. After watching the breathtaking sunrise and exploring the crater, return to the parking area for a brief break and enjoy a cup of Arabica coffee. Finally, we will transfer you to Ketapang Harbour to take the ferry back to Bali, bringing your volcanic adventure to a close. End of the program.

You'll witness the stunning sight of Mount Batok, Mount Bromo, and Gunung Semeru, Indonesia's highest and most active volcano, looming majestically in the background. After the sunrise, embark on an exciting 4WD ride or motorcycle journey across the vast volcanic sand sea (Laotan Pasir) to Poten, a Tenggerese Hindu temple near Mount Bromo. From here, you have the option to either hike 3km or take a pony ride to the base of Mount Bromo, where you can climb the 253 steps to the crater rim for close-up views of the active crater. After enjoying the spectacular views of the Bromo crater, continue your journey to Bondowoso City. Check into your hotel and recharge your energy in preparation for the Ijen Crater hike the next day.

itinerary_days.title: Day 3
itinerary_days.activity_text: Your Ijen adventure begins at midnight with a 90-minute drive from the hotel to the Ijen Ranger Post (Paltuding). Upon arrival, begin the trek to Ijen Crater, which will take approximately 1 to 1.5 hours. At the crater rim, be mesmerized by the gigantic turquoise sulfuric crater lake, one of the most unique sights in Java. While at the crater, you'll have the chance to observe the world’s toughest sulfur miners who brave toxic fumes and hazardous terrain to carry 70kg sacks of sulfur. This is a truly humbling experience that reveals the hardships faced by these workers. After watching the breathtaking sunrise and exploring the crater, return to the parking area for a brief break and enjoy a cup of Arabica coffee. Finally, we will transfer you to Ketapang Harbour to take the ferry back to Bali, bringing your volcanic adventure to a close. End of the program.

records.package_name: 5 Day Ijen, Papuma Beach, Tumpak Sewu & Bromo Discovery from Bali to Surabaya

itinerary_days.title: Day 1
itinerary_days.activity_text: The tour begins with a pickup from your hotel in Bali. It’s recommended to start before 10 AM Bali local time. From there, enjoy a 4-hour scenic drive to Gilimanuk Port for a ferry crossing to Java (Ketapang Port). The crossing takes about an hour, with views of Mount Agung in Bali and Mount Raung in Java (weather permitting). Upon arrival at Ketapang Port, you’ll be transferred directly to your hotel in Banyuwangi.

itinerary_days.title: Day 2
itinerary_days.activity_text: Depart from hotel at 12.30 AM - depart to Mount Ijen - start hiking - coffee break - Transfer to hotel at Tumpak Sewu Area - Check In - Take a rest

itinerary_days.title: Day 3
itinerary_days.activity_text: Start early at 4 AM and check out from your hotel. Travel to Tumpak Sewu Waterfall, often regarded as the most beautiful waterfall in Java. Its unique formation resembles a curtain of water cascading from 300-meter-high cliffs. Trek through the canyon, following the river and crossing it at one point to fully experience the falls. Trekking sandals or shoes are highly recommended. After enjoying the waterfall and a water spa, have lunch before driving approximately 4 hours to your hotel in the Bromo area. Check in and rest for the next day’s adventure.

itinerary_days.title: Day 4
itinerary_days.itinerary: Bromo Sunrise - Madakaripura Waterfall - Surabaya City
itinerary_days.activity_text: Depart at 2am by private jeep to Bromo (Sunrise - Bromo Crater Rim- Whispering Sands) - Breakfast and Shower - check out - continue to Madakaripura waterfall - to the next hotel.

itinerary_days.title: Day 5
itinerary_days.activity_text: After breakfast at your hotel, you’ll be transferred to Juanda International Airport for your flight back home, marking the end of your East Java expedition.
